selection_criterion: highest cross-validated recall (sensitivity) on the training split - a missed case costs more than a false alarm in a screening tool

excluded_features.oldpeak: ST depression induced by exercise - needs a stress test
excluded_features.slope: slope of peak exercise ST segment - needs a stress test
excluded_features.ca: major vessels coloured by fluoroscopy - needs cardiac imaging
excluded_features.thal: thallium scintigraphy result - needs a nuclear scan

target_definition: 1 if num > 0 (>50% diameter narrowing in any major vessel)

feature_encoding.cp: 1 = typical angina, 2 = atypical angina, 3 = non-anginal pain, 4 = asymptomatic
feature_encoding.trestbps: resting systolic blood pressure, mm Hg
feature_encoding.fbs: 1 if fasting blood sugar > 120 mg/dl else 0
feature_encoding.restecg: 0 = normal, 1 = ST-T wave abnormality, 2 = left ventricular hypertrophy
